salary_details.details: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 1,33,623/- p.m to Rs. 1,45,530/- p.m, depending on experience. The tenure for the position is up to 31 July 2027, and candidates are required to join immediately. Hostel accommodation is available on campus subject to availability.

important_instructions: Candidates must appear for the walk-in interview within the reporting time only (10:00 AM to 10:15 AM on 26 October 2026). Senior Residents must pay a Security / Caution Deposit of Rs. 1,33,623/- at the time of joining, or have it deducted in five equal installments from their salary. The deposit is refunded without interest after completion of SRship or 01-year fellowship. Residents may resign after completing five months of service by giving a one-month notice (completing 6 months of total service) to remain eligible for the deposit refund. Leaving the post without serving the required notice period results in the forfeiture of the last month's salary (30 days). Hostel accommodation is available on campus subject to availability.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date for the ACTREC Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 10:00 AM and 10:15 AM on the interview date.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview takes place at Meeting Room 306, 3rd Floor, Paymaster Shodhika, Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education Centre (ACTREC), Sector-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai – 410 210.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD/DNB (Pathology) or equivalent PG degree recognized by the NMC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as on the advertisement date, with age relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the consolidated salary offered?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated salary ranges from Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,45,530/- based on experience.

faq.question: Q7. What documents do I need to bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a recent CV, passport size photograph, original and xerox copies of educational and work experience certificates, and an Aadhaar Card.

faq.question: Q8. Is hostel accommodation provided?
faq.answer: Hostel accommodation is available on campus subject to availability.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The tenure is up to 31 July 2027, and selected candidates are required to join immediately.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a security deposit required upon joining?
faq.answer: Yes, a security or caution deposit of Rs. 1,33,623/- is payable at joining or can be deducted in five equal installments from the salary.
